protocol: Fixed adaptive research ablations, no hyperparameter search. Seven outer match exclusions. New quality training uses separately seeded synthetic offset/frozen ghosts, never possession references. Training features for gap/boundary heads use upstream and quality models excluding both outer and training fixture. Gap head learns from missing-ball alive rows only, weighted by sampled possession. New boundary head uses original class-prior-restoring sampler. Compare frozen event4, baseline, quality-only, gap-only, boundary-only and combined. Original clean/moderate/severe/contextual inputs and three noisy seeds remain identical. Contextual ghost labels only evaluate quality; do not train on the contextual stress cases. Report provider and evaluation-only 1/3/5-second absorbed references. No competition data, no automatic production promotion. Prior researcher adaptation and overlapping training sets limit inferential claims.
